instruction: I have an extensive movie collection in the opened Excel file. I'm interested in reviewing films from the first decade of the 2000s. Create a new sheet named '2000s_movies' that includes all movies released from 2000 to 2010 (inclusive). Keep the same column headers and organize them first by release year (earliest first), then by rating (highest first) for movies within the same year.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires filtering movies from 2000-2010 and sorting by year ascending (primary) then rating descending (secondary). Verified with Python: 31 movies from 2000-2010 period. Evaluator checks two-level sorting: primary sort by release year column (index 1) ascending, and secondary sort by ratings column (index 2) descending for movies with the same year.
